# Café Academy

> Café Academy teaches you to brew world-class coffee at home with detailed recipes, professional techniques and barista tips — and delivers fresh coffee in Market Harborough and surrounding villages.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured coffee recipes and an introduction to Café Academy.
- [Menu](/menu): Full menu of coffees available for ordering and learning.
- [Espresso recipe](/coffee/espresso): How to pull a perfect espresso shot.
- [Cappuccino recipe](/coffee/cappuccino): Steamed milk, microfoam and the classic 1:1:1 ratio.
- [Latte recipe](/coffee/latte): Smooth coffee with steamed milk and a thin foam layer.
- [Americano recipe](/coffee/americano): Espresso lengthened with hot water.
- [Delivery](/delivery): Coffee delivery across Market Harborough, Lubenham, Great Bowden and Little Bowden (5km radius).
- [Track order](/track-order): Look up the status of an existing order.
- [Help](/help): Ordering, delivery, payment and QR-code FAQ.
- [Install](/install): Install Café Academy as a Progressive Web App.
- [Sign in](/auth): Customer sign in and sign up.

## Optional

- [QR code](/qrcode): Generate a QR code that links to the menu.
